messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | Dubai Holding | Impact, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Buhumaid,

I am sharing an executive value proposition prepared for Dubai Holding, together with my three-page executive CV. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships and executive advisory.

Dubai Holding's scale across investment, real estate, hospitality, infrastructure and sustainability-led growth creates strong alignment with my experience. My background is particularly relevant where portfolio strategy, government relationships, ESG governance, reputation, major projects and operating delivery need disciplined coordination.

The attached brief sets out practical areas where I could support Dubai Holding or selected portfolio businesses, including stakeholder strategy, responsible investment, government affairs, strategic partnerships, energy transition and executive issue management. It includes a 90-180 day action framework.

I would value a confidential discussion regarding senior opportunities across Dubai Holding or its portfolio. Given your leadership across impact, sustainability and corporate positioning, I would also appreciate your guidance if another executive or business unit represents the strongest fit.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Executive Value Proposition for Dubai Holding
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Dubai Holding's diversified portfolio creates a complex interface among investment strategy, government stakeholders, ESG commitments, reputation and operating execution. My value proposition is to strengthen that interface. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead government and regulatory relations, ESG coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a capital-intensive multinational environment.
strategic_brief.company_context: Dubai Holding is a diversified investment group spanning major sectors that shape Dubai's economic growth and global positioning. Its sustainability and impact agenda depends on translating group-level commitments into portfolio-level evidence, stakeholder confidence and measurable execution.

opportunities.title: Portfolio ESG Execution
opportunities.rationale: A diversified portfolio needs consistent evidence and accountability across sustainability priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Connect impact commitments to operating evidence, portfolio ownership and executive reporting.

opportunities.title: Government and Institutional Stakeholder Strategy
opportunities.rationale: Major developments and investments depend on coordinated public-sector relationships.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Build stakeholder architectures, engagement plans, commitment trackers and escalation routes.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships
opportunities.rationale: Portfolio growth benefits from structured partnerships that connect commercial outcomes with public priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Translate institutional priorities into executable partnership workstreams and measurable commitments.

opportunities.title: Executive Issues and Reputation
opportunities.rationale: High-profile assets require disciplined handling of sensitive external issues.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: Develop executive briefs, evidence trackers and cross-functional issue-management protocols.

days_0_30: Map priority portfolio and stakeholder dependencies.
Review ESG evidence and issue-escalation processes.
days_31_60: Build integrated stakeholder and impact action plans.
days_91_180: Measure stakeholder, impact and execution outcomes.

background_relevance: Current Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group.
Government, regulatory, ESG, corporate affairs and executive advisory leadership.
Renewable-energy stakeholder governance and carbon-data traceability experience.
12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.
